question: Aman can do (1)/(6) th of a piece of work in 13 days and Chaman can do (1)/(7) th of the same work in 19 days. Find the number of days taken to complete the work if both work together. (Rounded off to one decimal place)
solution:
**Given:**

Aman completes 1/6 work = 13 days

Chaman completes 1/7 work = 19 days

**Formula used:**

Time = Total Work / Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Aman's full work time = 13 × 6 = 78 days

Chaman's full work time = 19 × 7 = 133 days

Total Work (LCM of 78 and 133) = 10374

Efficiency (Aman) = 10374 / 78 = 133

Efficiency (Chaman) = 10374 / 133 = 78

⇒ Combined Efficiency = 133 + 78 = 211

⇒ Days taken = 10374 / 211

⇒ Days taken = 49.165...

⇒ Days taken ≈ 49.2

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
